lede: The most consequential meeting this week is Telluride's HARC on Tuesday, October 21, where the Town's own Shandoka Lot Redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Rd goes before the commission — two public hearings covering four new buildings in an Accommodations 2 zone, both continued from August. Norwood's Planning and Zoning Commission also meets Monday to take up a Land Use Code Update and a Master Plan Update, foundational decisions that will shape what gets built there for years. On the community side, the San Miguel Watershed Forum on funding water projects and two separate water-focused talks later in the week are worth a look if that's on your radar.

notable.stake: Land Use Code and Master Plan updates could reshape Norwood's development rules.
Public hearings on four new buildings in the Town's own large-scale Shandoka redevelopment.
